title: Best-Seeing Nights Ranking
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography capture software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — logging to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mount:status
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(guide_rms_arcsec) as rms, min(guide_rms_arcsec) as best by _time
| sort rms
| head 10
description: Ranks your calmest, steadiest nights by guiding performance so you can plan demanding targets for similar conditions.
value: Atmospheric steadiness makes or breaks planetary and fine detail; knowing your best nights helps you recognise and use them.
implementation: Ingest nightly guiding statistics; rank nights by average steadiness.
visualization: Ranked table of nights by guiding steadiness.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks your steadiest, calmest nights for stargazing, so you can plan tricky targets for the best conditions.
